Method of Attack: heap-based buffer overflow when handling DER-encoded DSA or RSA-PSS signatures
exploitation can lead to program crashes, arbitrary code execution, and bypassing security software
Impacted Systems: Network Security Services (NSS) versions before 3.73 or 3.68.1 ESR
email clients and PDF viewers using vulnerable NSS versions
applications using NSS for handling signatures encoded within CMS, S/MIME, PKCS #7, or PKCS #12
applications using NSS for certificate validation or other TLS, X.509, OCSP or CRL functionality depending on configuration

Mozilla, Red Hat, SUSE products including Firefox, Thunderbird, SeaMonkey, Firefox OS, Evolution, Pidgin, Apache OpenOffice, LibreOffice, Red Hat Directory Server, Red Hat Certificate System, mod_nss SSL module for Apache, Oracle Communications Messaging Server, Oracle Directory Server Enterprise Edition, SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
